title: Quotas kind: flow
[At create] gray create: Create a store | KVStore, Bucket, SQLDatabase room: Room in the namespace? | its count cap made: Store created @green r400: 400 Bad Request | the maximum reached @red [/]
[On each write] gray write: A write | KV, S3 or SQL cap: Within spec.quota? | maxSize or maxBytes kept: Write stored @green r507: 507 Insufficient Storage | S3 QuotaExceeded @red [/]
create > room room > made: yes room > r400: no write > cap cap > kept: yes cap > r507: no
